resources.string: Gives the files you actually asked for — the ones you tapped, the video you are watching and the media in the chat you have open — the most connections and the first place in the download queue, while background auto-download gets whatever is left. Interrupted downloads continue from the last part that was fully written to disk.
Keep what has already been downloaded when a transfer is cancelled or fails, so that starting it again resumes instead of downloading the file from the beginning.
